reached_sql:
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20) AS reason_description,
    AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_ws_quantity,
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_wr_refunded_cash,
    AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_wr_fee
FROM (
    SELECT 
        web_sales.ws_item_sk, 
        web_returns.wr_reason_sk, 
        web_sales.ws_order_number, 
        cd1.cd_marital_status, 
        cd1.cd_education_status, 
        web_sales.ws_sales_price,
        customer_address.ca_country, 
        customer_address.ca_state
    FROM 
        web_sales 
    JOIN 
        web_returns ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
    JOIN 
        web_page ON web_sales.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN 
        customer_demographics AS cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN 
        customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk
    JOIN 
        customer_demographics AS cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
) AS subquery
WHERE 
    d_year = 1998 AND 
    ((cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00) 
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00) 
    OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)) 
    AND ((customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) 
    OR (customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300) 
    OR (customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250))
GROUP BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee)
ORDER BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws_quantity), AVG(wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
